fluff.overview: Most Clan infantry are solahma warriors at the end of their careers or who have failed their Trials, assigned to duties the warrior caste considers beneath notice. Mechanized Wheeled Points use wheeled armored vehicles that balance speed and protection better than hovercraft or motorcycles. Effective on developed road networks and open terrain, they sacrifice the all-terrain capability of tracked vehicles for better sustained speed on firm ground. Armed with standard ballistic assault rifles, the most common and affordable infantry weapon available, these Points deliver reliable short-range firepower and can be equipped and resupplied from almost any garrison stockpile.
